findings.heading: Time-dependent covariates in survival models / Covariables tiempo-dependientes en modelos de supervivencia
findings.proposition: English asks about a covariate measured after follow-up time BEGINS; the Spanish drops 'begins' and asks about a covariate measured 'despues del tiempo de seguimiento', i.e. after the follow-up period.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader takes a time-dependent covariate to be something measured after follow-up has ended, not something measured during follow-up, which is the opposite of the situation the tmerge/tdc setup in this section handles.

findings.heading: Data management and transformation / Gestion y transformacion de datos
findings.proposition: English says event = 0 marks a patient who was RIGHT CENSORED; the Spanish says 'si fue correctamente censurado' (if he was CORRECTLY censored), translating the direction 'right' as the adverb 'correct'.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader reads the 0 code as meaning the censoring was done properly rather than as right censoring, losing the link to the 'censura derecha' concept defined in the Overview and to the Surv() right-censored data structure.

findings.heading: Building a surv-type object / Construir un objeto de tipo surv-type
findings.proposition: English says the Surv() syntax shown is for RIGHT-CENSORED data; the Spanish says it is for 'datos correctamente censurados' (correctly censored data).
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader does not learn that this two-argument Surv(time, event) form is the right-censoring form specifically, so they will not know a different form is needed for interval or left censoring, or for the start/stop form used later in the time-dependent section.

findings.heading: Cox regression with time-dependent covariates / Regresion de Cox con covariables dependientes del tiempo
findings.proposition: English attributes ggforest() to the survminer package; the Spanish attributes it to a package named 'urvminer', which does not exist and is not the package loaded in the setup chunk.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader looking up or installing the package named in the sentence finds nothing, and cannot connect ggforest() to the survminer package that the chapter actually loads.

findings.heading: Building a surv-type object / Construir un objeto de tipo surv-type
findings.proposition: The Spanish adds a positional claim that the '+' appears 'a la derecha' (to the right) of the value, and correspondingly describes the observation only as 'censurada' rather than as right-censored.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader learns the plus sign as a layout detail about print position instead of as the marker of right censoring, so the printed Surv vector no longer teaches what censoring type the object encodes.
